paragraphs.text: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
paragraphs.original: Ἤγγιζεν δὲ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων ἡ λεγομένη Πάσχα.
paragraphs.translit: Ēngizen de hē heortē tōn azymōn hē legomenē Pascha.

paragraphs.text: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death; for they feared the people.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὸ πῶς ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν, ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ezētoun hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis to pōs anelōsin auton, ephobounto gar ton laon.

paragraphs.text: And Satan entered into Judas who was called Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
paragraphs.original: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Σατανᾶς εἰς Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Ἰσκαριώτην, ὄντα ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τῶν δώδεκα·
paragraphs.translit: Eisēlthen de Satanas eis Ioudan ton kaloumenon Iskariōtēn, onta ek tou arithmou tōn dōdeka·

paragraphs.text: And he went away, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might deliver him unto them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπελθὼν συνελάλησεν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ στρατηγοῖς τὸ πῶς αὐτοῖς παραδῷ αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai apelthōn synelalēsen tois archiereusin kai stratēgois to pōs autois paradō auton.

paragraphs.text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐχάρησαν καὶ συνέθεντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι.
paragraphs.translit: kai echarēsan kai synethento autō argyrion dounai.

paragraphs.text: And he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξωμολόγησεν, καὶ ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν ἄτερ ὄχλου αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai exōmologēsen, kai ezētei eukairian tou paradounai auton ater ochlou autois.

paragraphs.text: And the day of unleavened bread came, on which the passover must be sacrificed.
paragraphs.original: Ἦλθεν δὲ ἡ ἡμέρα τῶν ἀζύμων, ᾗ ἔδει θύεσθαι τὸ πάσχα·
paragraphs.translit: Ēlthen de hē hēmera tōn azymōn, hē edei thyesthai to pascha·

paragraphs.text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην εἰπών· Πορευθέντες ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν τὸ πάσχα ἵνα φάγωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai apesteilen Petron kai Iōannēn eipōn· Poreuthentes hetoimasate hēmin to pascha hina phagōmen.

paragraphs.text: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we make ready?
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμεν;
paragraphs.translit: hoi de eipan autō· Pou theleis hetoimasōmen;

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house whereinto he goeth.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἰδοὺ εἰσελθόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν πόλιν συναντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων· ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεται.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen autois· Idou eiselthontōn hymōn eis tēn polin synantēsei hymin anthrōpos keramion hydatos bastazōn· akolouthēsate autō eis tēn oikian eis hēn eisporeuetai.

paragraphs.text: And ye shall say unto the master of the house, The Teacher saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ τῆς οἰκίας· Λέγει σοι ὁ διδάσκαλος· Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμα ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω;
paragraphs.translit: kai ereite tō oikodespotē tēs oikias· Legei soi ho didaskalos· Pou estin to katalyma hopou to pascha meta tōn mathētōn mou phagō;

paragraphs.text: And he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
paragraphs.original: κἀκεῖνος ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον· ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε.
paragraphs.translit: kakeinos hymin deixei anagaion mega estrōmenon· ekei hetoimasate.

paragraphs.text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
paragraphs.original: ἀπελθόντες δὲ εὗρον καθὼς εἰρήκει αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.
paragraphs.translit: apelthontes de heuron kathōs eirēkei autois, kai hētoimasan to pascha.

paragraphs.text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the apostles with him.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡ ὥρα, ἀνέπεσεν καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι σὺν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hote egeneto hē hōra, anepesen kai hoi apostoloi syn autō.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἐπεθύμησα τοῦτο τὸ πάσχα φαγεῖν μεθʼ ὑμῶν πρὸ τοῦ με παθεῖν·
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen pros autous· Epithymia epethymēsa touto to pascha phagein methʼ hymōn pro tou me pathein·

paragraphs.text: for I say unto you, I shall not eat it, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
paragraphs.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ φάγω αὐτὸ ἕως ὅτου πληρωθῇ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: legō gar hymin hoti ou mē phagō auto heōs hotou plērōthē en tē basileia tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And he received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
paragraphs.original: καὶ δεξάμενος ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας εἶπεν· Λάβετε τοῦτο καὶ διαμερίσατε εἰς ἑαυτούς·
paragraphs.translit: kai dexamenos potērion eucharistēsas eipen· Labete touto kai diamerisate eis heautous·

paragraphs.text: for I say unto you, I shall not drink from henceforth of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
paragraphs.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως οὗ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἔλθῃ.
paragraphs.translit: legō gar hymin, ou mē piō apo tou nyn apo tou genēmatos tēs ampelou heōs hou hē basileia tou theou elthē.

paragraphs.text: And he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου [τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν διδόμενον· τοῦτο ποιεῖτε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai labōn arton eucharistēsas eklasen kai edōken autois legōn· Touto estin to sōma mou [to hyper hymōn didomenon· touto poieite eis tēn emēn anamnēsin.

paragraphs.text: And the cup in like manner after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood, [even] that which is poured out for you.
paragraphs.original: ⸄καὶ τὸ ποτήριον ὡσαύτως⸅ μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι, λέγων· Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐν τῷ αἵματί μου, τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐκχυννόμενον].
paragraphs.translit: ⸄kai to potērion hōsautōs⸅ meta to deipnēsai, legōn· Touto to potērion hē kainē diathēkē en tō haimati mou, to hyper hymōn ekchynnomenon].

paragraphs.text: But behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
paragraphs.original: πλὴν ἰδοὺ ἡ χεὶρ τοῦ παραδιδόντος με μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης·
paragraphs.translit: plēn idou hē cheir tou paradidontos me metʼ emou epi tēs trapezēs·

paragraphs.text: For the Son of man indeed goeth, as it hath been determined: but woe unto that man through whom he is betrayed!
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς μὲν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου κατὰ τὸ ὡρισμένον πορεύεται, πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ διʼ οὗ παραδίδοται.
paragraphs.translit: hoti ho hyios men tou anthrōpou kata to hōrismenon poreuetai, plēn ouai tō anthrōpō ekeinō diʼ hou paradidotai.

paragraphs.text: And they began to question among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς τὸ τίς ἄρα εἴη ἐξ αὐτῶν ὁ τοῦτο μέλλων πράσσειν.
paragraphs.translit: kai autoi ērxanto syzētein pros heautous to tis ara eiē ex autōn ho touto mellōn prassein.

paragraphs.text: And there arose also a contention among them, which of them was accounted to be greatest.
paragraphs.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ καὶ φιλονεικία ἐν αὐτοῖς, τὸ τίς αὐτῶν δοκεῖ εἶναι μείζων.
paragraphs.translit: Egeneto de kai philoneikia en autois, to tis autōn dokei einai meizōn.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles have lordship over them; and they that have authority over them are called Benefactors.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν κυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐξουσιάζοντες αὐτῶν εὐεργέται καλοῦνται.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen autois· Hoi basileis tōn ethnōn kyrieuousin autōn kai hoi exousiazontes autōn euergetai kalountai.

paragraphs.text: But ye [shall] not [be] so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως, ἀλλʼ ὁ μείζων ἐν ὑμῖν γινέσθω ὡς ὁ νεώτερος, καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος ὡς ὁ διακονῶν·
paragraphs.translit: hymeis de ouch houtōs, allʼ ho meizōn en hymin ginesthō hōs ho neōteros, kai ho hēgoumenos hōs ho diakonōn·

paragraphs.text: For which is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am in the midst of you as he that serveth.
paragraphs.original: τίς γὰρ μείζων, ὁ ἀνακείμενος ἢ ὁ διακονῶν; οὐχὶ ὁ ἀνακείμενος; ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν εἰμι ὡς ὁ διακονῶν.
paragraphs.translit: tis gar meizōn, ho anakeimenos ē ho diakonōn; ouchi ho anakeimenos; egō de en mesō hymōn eimi hōs ho diakonōn.

paragraphs.text: But ye are they that have continued with me in my temptations;
paragraphs.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε οἱ διαμεμενηκότες μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐν τοῖς πειρασμοῖς μου·
paragraphs.translit: Hymeis de este hoi diamemenēkotes metʼ emou en tois peirasmois mou·

paragraphs.text: and I appoint unto you a kingdom, even as my Father appointed unto me,
paragraphs.original: κἀγὼ διατίθεμαι ὑμῖν, καθὼς διέθετό μοι ὁ πατήρ μου βασιλείαν,
paragraphs.translit: kagō diatithemai hymin, kathōs dietheto moi ho patēr mou basileian,

paragraphs.text: that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom; and ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ἔσθητε καὶ πίνητε ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ μου, καὶ καθήσεσθε ἐπὶ θρόνων τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς κρίνοντες τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
paragraphs.translit: hina esthēte kai pinēte epi tēs trapezēs mou en tē basileia mou, kai kathēsesthe epi thronōn tas dōdeka phylas krinontes tou Israēl.

paragraphs.text: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat:
paragraphs.original: Σίμων Σίμων, ἰδοὺ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐξῃτήσατο ὑμᾶς τοῦ σινιάσαι ὡς τὸν σῖτον·
paragraphs.translit: Simōn Simōn, idou ho Satanas exētēsato hymas tou siniasai hōs ton siton·

paragraphs.text: but I made supplication for thee, that thy faith fail not; and do thou, when once thou hast turned again, establish thy brethren.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐδεήθην περὶ σοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἐκλίπῃ ἡ πίστις σου· καὶ σύ ποτε ἐπιστρέψας στήρισον τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου.
paragraphs.translit: egō de edeēthēn peri sou hina mē eklipē hē pistis sou· kai sy pote epistrepsas stērison tous adelphous sou.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto him, Lord, with thee I am ready to go both to prison and to death.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, μετὰ σοῦ ἕτοιμός εἰμι καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν καὶ εἰς θάνατον πορεύεσθαι.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen autō· Kyrie, meta sou hetoimos eimi kai eis phylakēn kai eis thanaton poreuesthai.

paragraphs.text: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, until thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Λέγω σοι, Πέτρε, οὐ φωνήσει σήμερον ἀλέκτωρ ἕως τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ εἰδέναι.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen· Legō soi, Petre, ou phōnēsei sēmeron alektōr heōs tris me aparnēsē eidenai.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, When I sent you forth without purse, and wallet, and shoes, lacked ye anything? And they said, Nothing.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὅτε ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς ἄτερ βαλλαντίου καὶ πήρας καὶ ὑποδημάτων, μή τινος ὑστερήσατε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Οὐθενός.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eipen autois· Hote apesteila hymas ater ballantiou kai pēras kai hypodēmatōn, mē tinos hysterēsate; hoi de eipan· Outhenos.

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet; and he that hath none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς· Ἀλλὰ νῦν ὁ ἔχων βαλλάντιον ἀράτω, ὁμοίως καὶ πήραν, καὶ ὁ μὴ ἔχων πωλησάτω τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀγορασάτω μάχαιραν.
paragraphs.translit: eipen de autois· Alla nyn ho echōn ballantion aratō, homoiōs kai pēran, kai ho mē echōn pōlēsatō to himation autou kai agorasatō machairan.

paragraphs.text: For I say unto you, that this which is written must be fulfilled in me, And he was reckoned with transgressors: for that which concerneth me hath fulfilment.
paragraphs.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦτο τὸ γεγραμμένον δεῖ τελεσθῆναι ἐν ἐμοί, τό· Καὶ μετὰ ἀνόμων ἐλογίσθη· καὶ γὰρ τὸ περὶ ἐμοῦ τέλος ἔχει.
paragraphs.translit: legō gar hymin hoti touto to gegrammenon dei telesthēnai en emoi, to· Kai meta anomōn elogisthē· kai gar to peri emou telos echei.

paragraphs.text: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Κύριε, ἰδοὺ μάχαιραι ὧδε δύο. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἱκανόν ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de eipan· Kyrie, idou machairai hōde dyo. ho de eipen autois· Hikanon estin.

paragraphs.text: And he came out, and went, as his custom was, unto the mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed him.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὸ ἔθος εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν· ἠκολούθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ μαθηταί.
paragraphs.translit: Kai exelthōn eporeuthē kata to ethos eis to Oros tōn Elaiōn· ēkolouthēsan de autō kai hoi mathētai.

paragraphs.text: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
paragraphs.original: γενόμενος δὲ ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Προσεύχεσθε μὴ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς πειρασμόν.
paragraphs.translit: genomenos de epi tou topou eipen autois· Proseuchesthe mē eiselthein eis peirasmon.

paragraphs.text: And he was parted from them about a stone`s cast; and he kneeled down and prayed,
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπεσπάσθη ἀπʼ αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύχετο
paragraphs.translit: kai autos apespasthē apʼ autōn hōsei lithou bolēn, kai theis ta gonata prosēucheto

paragraphs.text: saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
paragraphs.original: λέγων· Πάτερ, εἰ βούλει παρένεγκε τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ· πλὴν μὴ τὸ θέλημά μου ἀλλὰ τὸ σὸν γινέσθω.
paragraphs.translit: legōn· Pater, ei boulei parenenke touto to potērion apʼ emou· plēn mē to thelēma mou alla to son ginesthō.

paragraphs.text: And there appeared unto him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.
paragraphs.original: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ ἐνισχύων αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: ōphthē de autō angelos apʼ ouranou enischyōn auton.

paragraphs.text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became as it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γενόμενος ἐν ἀγωνίᾳ ἐκτενέστερον προσηύχετο· ⸄καὶ ἐγένετο⸅ ὁ ἱδρὼς αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ θρόμβοι αἵματος καταβαίνοντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν.
paragraphs.translit: kai genomenos en agōnia ektenesteron prosēucheto· ⸄kai egeneto⸅ ho hidrōs autou hōsei thromboi haimatos katabainontes epi tēn gēn.

paragraphs.text: And when he rose up from his prayer, he came unto the disciples, and found them sleeping for sorrow,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπὸ τῆς προσευχῆς ἐλθὼν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εὗρεν κοιμωμένους αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς λύπης,
paragraphs.translit: kai anastas apo tēs proseuchēs elthōn pros tous mathētas heuren koimōmenous autous apo tēs lypēs,

paragraphs.text: and said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τί καθεύδετε; ἀναστάντες προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen autois· Ti katheudete; anastantes proseuchesthe, hina mē eiselthēte eis peirasmon.

paragraphs.text: While he yet spake, behold, a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them; and he drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
paragraphs.original: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ ὄχλος, καὶ ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα προήρχετο αὐτούς, καὶ ἤγγισεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ φιλῆσαι αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Eti autou lalountos idou ochlos, kai ho legomenos Ioudas heis tōn dōdeka proērcheto autous, kai ēngisen tō Iēsou philēsai auton.

paragraphs.text: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
paragraphs.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἰούδα, φιλήματι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδως;
paragraphs.translit: Iēsous de eipen autō· Iouda, philēmati ton hyion tou anthrōpou paradidōs;

paragraphs.text: And when they that were about him saw what would follow, they said, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
paragraphs.original: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν τὸ ἐσόμενον εἶπαν· Κύριε, εἰ πατάξομεν ἐν μαχαίρῃ;
paragraphs.translit: idontes de hoi peri auton to esomenon eipan· Kyrie, ei pataxomen en machairē;

paragraphs.text: And a certain one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his right ear.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπάταξεν εἷς τις ἐξ αὐτῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τὸν δοῦλον καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ τὸ δεξιόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai epataxen heis tis ex autōn tou archiereōs ton doulon kai apheilen to ous autou to dexion.

paragraphs.text: But Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye [them] thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἐᾶτε ἕως τούτου· καὶ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὠτίου ἰάσατο αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen· Eate heōs toutou· kai hapsamenos tou ōtiou iasato auton.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and elders, that were come against him, Are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves?
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν δὲ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς παραγενομένους ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ στρατηγοὺς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ πρεσβυτέρους· Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων;
paragraphs.translit: eipen de Iēsous pros tous paragenomenous epʼ auton archiereis kai stratēgous tou hierou kai presbyterous· Hōs epi lēstēn exēlthate meta machairōn kai xylōn;

paragraphs.text: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched not forth your hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
paragraphs.original: καθʼ ἡμέραν ὄντος μου μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὐκ ἐξετείνατε τὰς χεῖρας ἐπʼ ἐμέ· ἀλλʼ αὕτη ἐστὶν ὑμῶν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ἡ ἐξουσία τοῦ σκότους.
paragraphs.translit: kathʼ hēmeran ontos mou methʼ hymōn en tō hierō ouk exeteinate tas cheiras epʼ eme· allʼ hautē estin hymōn hē hōra kai hē exousia tou skotous.

paragraphs.text: And they seized him, and led him [away], and brought him into the high priest`s house. But Peter followed afar off.
paragraphs.original: Συλλαβόντες δὲ αὐτὸν ἤγαγον καὶ εἰσήγαγον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως· ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει μακρόθεν.
paragraphs.translit: Syllabontes de auton ēgagon kai eisēgagon eis tēn oikian tou archiereōs· ho de Petros ēkolouthei makrothen.

paragraphs.text: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the court, and had sat down together, Peter sat in the midst of them.
paragraphs.original: περιαψάντων δὲ πῦρ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ συγκαθισάντων ἐκάθητο ὁ Πέτρος μέσος αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: periapsantōn de pyr en mesō tēs aulēs kai synkathisantōn ekathēto ho Petros mesos autōn.

paragraphs.text: And a certain maid seeing him as he sat in the light [of the fire], and looking stedfastly upon him, said, This man also was with him.
paragraphs.original: ἰδοῦσα δὲ αὐτὸν παιδίσκη τις καθήμενον πρὸς τὸ φῶς καὶ ἀτενίσασα αὐτῷ εἶπεν· Καὶ οὗτος σὺν αὐτῷ ἦν·
paragraphs.translit: idousa de auton paidiskē tis kathēmenon pros to phōs kai atenisasa autō eipen· Kai houtos syn autō ēn·

paragraphs.text: But he denied, saying, Woman, I know him not.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων· Οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, γύναι.
paragraphs.translit: ho de ērnēsato legōn· Ouk oida auton, gynai.

paragraphs.text: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou also art [one] of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.
paragraphs.original: καὶ μετὰ βραχὺ ἕτερος ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἔφη· Καὶ σὺ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ· ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη· Ἄνθρωπε, οὐκ εἰμί.
paragraphs.translit: kai meta brachy heteros idōn auton ephē· Kai sy ex autōn ei· ho de Petros ephē· Anthrōpe, ouk eimi.

paragraphs.text: And after the space of about one hour another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this man also was with him; for he is a Galilaean.
paragraphs.original: καὶ διαστάσης ὡσεὶ ὥρας μιᾶς ἄλλος τις διϊσχυρίζετο λέγων· Ἐπʼ ἀληθείας καὶ οὗτος μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἦν, καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν·
paragraphs.translit: kai diastasēs hōsei hōras mias allos tis diischyrizeto legōn· Epʼ alētheias kai houtos metʼ autou ēn, kai gar Galilaios estin·

paragraphs.text: But Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος· Ἄνθρωπε, οὐκ οἶδα ὃ λέγεις. καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔτι λαλοῦντος αὐτοῦ ἐφώνησεν ἀλέκτωρ.
paragraphs.translit: eipen de ho Petros· Anthrōpe, ouk oida ho legeis. kai parachrēma eti lalountos autou ephōnēsen alektōr.

paragraphs.text: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how that he said unto him, Before the cock crow this day thou shalt deny me thrice.
paragraphs.original: καὶ στραφεὶς ὁ κύριος ἐνέβλεψεν τῷ Πέτρῳ, καὶ ὑπεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τοῦ λόγου τοῦ κυρίου ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι σήμερον ἀπαρνήσῃ με τρίς.
paragraphs.translit: kai strapheis ho kyrios eneblepsen tō Petrō, kai hypemnēsthē ho Petros tou logou tou kyriou hōs eipen autō hoti Prin alektora phōnēsai sēmeron aparnēsē me tris.

paragraphs.text: And he went out, and wept bitterly.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς.
paragraphs.translit: kai exelthōn exō eklausen pikrōs.

paragraphs.text: And the men that held [Jesus] mocked him, and beat him.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ συνέχοντες αὐτὸν ἐνέπαιζον αὐτῷ δέροντες,
paragraphs.translit: Kai hoi andres hoi synechontes auton enepaizon autō derontes,

paragraphs.text: And they blindfolded him, and asked him, saying, Prophesy: who is he that struck thee?
paragraphs.original: καὶ περικαλύψαντες αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτων λέγοντες· Προφήτευσον, τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε;
paragraphs.translit: kai perikalypsantes auton epērōtōn legontes· Prophēteuson, tis estin ho paisas se;

paragraphs.text: And many other things spake they against him, reviling him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἕτερα πολλὰ βλασφημοῦντες ἔλεγον εἰς αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hetera polla blasphēmountes elegon eis auton.

paragraphs.text: And as soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes; and they led him away into their council, saying,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡμέρα, συνήχθη τὸ πρεσβυτέριον τοῦ λαοῦ, ἀρχιερεῖς τε καὶ γραμματεῖς, καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ συνέδριον αὐτῶν,
paragraphs.translit: Kai hōs egeneto hēmera, synēchthē to presbyterion tou laou, archiereis te kai grammateis, kai apēgagon auton eis to synedrion autōn,

paragraphs.text: If thou art the Christ, tell us. But he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
paragraphs.original: λέγοντες· Εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστός, εἰπὸν ἡμῖν. εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς· Ἐὰν ὑμῖν εἴπω οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε·
paragraphs.translit: legontes· Ei sy ei ho christos, eipon hēmin. eipen de autois· Ean hymin eipō ou mē pisteusēte·

paragraphs.text: and if I ask [you], ye will not answer.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἐρωτήσω, οὐ μὴ ἀποκριθῆτε.
paragraphs.translit: ean de erōtēsō, ou mē apokrithēte.

paragraphs.text: But from henceforth shall the Son of man be seated at the right hand of the power of God.
paragraphs.original: ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν δὲ ἔσται ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καθήμενος ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: apo tou nyn de estai ho hyios tou anthrōpou kathēmenos ek dexiōn tēs dynameōs tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And they all said, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
paragraphs.original: εἶπαν δὲ πάντες· Σὺ οὖν εἶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ; ὁ δὲ πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἔφη· Ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.
paragraphs.translit: eipan de pantes· Sy oun ei ho hyios tou theou; ho de pros autous ephē· Hymeis legete hoti egō eimi.

paragraphs.text: And they said, What further need have we of witness? for we ourselves have heard from his own mouth.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Τί ἔτι ἔχομεν μαρτυρίας χρείαν; αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἠκούσαμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de eipan· Ti eti echomen martyrias chreian; autoi gar ēkousamen apo tou stomatos autou.
